1.1.0: Realtime weather now switches the hourly music of your chosen game to its rainy or snowy version (and random mode only picks fitting games)
New weather report page: current conditions, feels like, humidity, wind, UV, precipitation, sunrise/sunset, the next 12 hours and a 3-day forecast
Weather strip on the home page, °C/°F toggle, and clearer error messages for API key problems
K.K. Slider now sits on stage and plays his guitar whenever his music is on, with a next-song button
Now-playing line shows the game and track currently playing
Weather refreshes every 15 minutes instead of only on the hour, and the request uses HTTPS
Fixed freezing drizzle not counting as rain, a broken saved API key check, and leaked audio contexts
Big code cleanup: the player and the window are split into small modules with unit tests
1.0.10: Added Population Growing - Rainy Day, will always play the same tune
Added label when minimized to tray to view the current tune's game and name
Added Open on startup option (thanks NoodleSushi!)
1.0.9: Added Wild World to City Folk label
1.0.7: Fix windows issue where if closed with the context menu or alt+f4 it wouldn't close
1.0.5: Add GitHub link and mac publish config
